The recommended starting dose for accelerated, myeloid, or lymphoid blast phase CML or Philadelphia chromosome-positive ALL is 70 mg twice daily. Dosage may be adjusted according to response and tolerability; doses of up to 140 mg once daily have been used in patients with chronic phase CML, and up to 100 mg twice daily in those with advanced phase, or with ALL. Treatment is continued until disease progression or unacceptable toxicity oc- curs. If concurrent use of potent inhibitors or inducers of cy- tochrome P450 isoenzyme CYP3A4 cannot be avoid- ed, dose adjustments are considered necessary. A dose increase should be considered in those patients given strong CYP3A4 inducers, and the patient should be monitored for toxicity. For those given a strong CYP3A4 inhibitor, the dose of dasatinib should be re- duced to 20 mg daily. If this is not tolerated, then either drug should be stopped; if the inhibitor is stopped, a washout period of about 1 week should be allowed be- fore the dose of dasatinib is increased. ◊ References. 1.
